operational-example.copy: Use Card Number Input to capture one card number with grouping, numeric keyboard, local Luhn validation, and recovery copy before a pattern or template handles backend validation.

scenario.title: Driver card onboarding
scenario.meta: Grouped card number and local validation

items.label: Card number
items.helper: Use the number printed on the front of the card.

rationale: It formats and validates one sensitive number without owning card enrollment.
It keeps Luhn, helper, error, autocomplete, and numeric keyboard together as one component.
Use a pattern later for CVV, expiry, backend validation, tokenization, and card ownership.

items.rule: Names the card number field and remains visible.
Uses Input rhythm, focus, density, and mono value styling.
Signals card capture without replacing label or helper text.
Formats digits in readable groups while preserving a raw numeric value for callbacks.
Uses Luhn only for local structure and never claims backend approval.

accessibility.statePrecedence: disabled, loading, error, valid, filled, default
items: Associate visible label and helper or error text with the input.
Use inputmode numeric and autocomplete cc-number.
Expose local validation with aria-invalid only when the number structure is invalid.
Do not announce or display full card ownership, backend approval, or tokenization from this component.
Preserve keyboard entry, paste, and correction.

variants.copy: Card Number Input variants describe local capture treatment. Expiry, CVC, and full card forms remain separate components or future patterns.

states.copy: States communicate entry, local validation, loading, error, and disabled behavior without owning payment submission.

variant-state-behavior.copy: Card Number Input has one local capture variant; state tells whether the value is empty, incomplete, valid, loading, invalid, or unavailable.

full-width.copy: Card Number Input fills onboarding and wallet forms while preserving grouped number rhythm.

responsive-layout-patterns.copy: Keep the full card number visible enough for correction. Move multi-field card enrollment into patterns after Card Number, Expiry, and Security Code components exist.

viewport-organization.copy: Card Number Input remains a single field component; viewport rules decide density and surrounding submit placement.

items.title: Phone
items.rule: Use large density and keep helper copy close to the field.

items.title: Tablet
items.rule: Keep it full width inside card setup panels.

items.title: Desktop
items.rule: Use standard density in admin or support forms.

playground.copy: Use the playground to verify grouping, Luhn state, helper copy, density, and disabled/loading behavior before composing card enrollment screens.

api-foundations.copy: Card Number Input API exposes one local card number field. It owns formatting and Luhn structure only; backend validation, tokenization, ownership, CVC, expiry, and submission stay outside the component.

props.name: value
props.notes: Formatted or raw card number value.

props.name: error
props.notes: Visible recovery message; overrides local Luhn message.

props.name: loading
props.notes: Shows a check in progress without claiming backend success.

props.name: onValueChange
props.notes: Called with raw digits, formatted value, brand hint, validity, and luhnValid.

groups.title: Use
items: Use Luhn only as local structure validation.
Keep helper and error copy direct.

groups.title: Avoid
items: Do not own CVC, expiry, or full payment form behavior.
Do not store or display sensitive card state beyond the field value.

groups.title: Review
items: Check PCI/product constraints before backend submission.
Check local error copy against the card program.

rejectIf: The component owns backend validation, tokenization, card ownership, or submission.
The value is not grouped or cannot be corrected.
Autocomplete and numeric input mode are missing.

miel.copy: MIEL treats Card Number Input as one sensitive field. Agents may place it for card capture, but humans confirm card program, validation copy, and surrounding enrollment system.
canDecide: Use Card Number Input for one card number.
Use Luhn for local structure validation.
Use loading only for a local or backend check in progress.
mustAsk: The system stores, tokenizes, validates with backend, or associates a card.
The card program may not use standard Luhn rules.
Expiry, CVC, brand selection, or payment ownership is required.
rejectIf: The component owns the full card form.
The component promises payment or ownership approval.
Sensitive card behavior is hidden in helper copy.
miel.handoff: I am using Card Number Input for one grouped card number with local Luhn validation. Please confirm the card program, backend validation path, recovery copy, and whether Expiry or Security Code components are also needed.
